title: Tensor opposite matrix conjugation splitting
statement: Given splittings of scalar extensions of central simple algebras A and B and their matrix conjugation lifts, the scalar extension of A tensor B opposite has a matrix splitting of size n*m whose conjugation lift is the Kronecker product with inverse transpose.

proof.text: Commute scalar extension and opposite algebra with the tensor product, apply the two splittings, transpose the opposite factor, and use the Kronecker algebra equivalence; verify on pure tensors and extend by bilinearity.

lean.statement: theorem exists_tensor_opposite_matrix_conjugation (K : Type u) [Field K] (A B : CSA.{u, u} K) (n m : ℕ) (eA : (SeparableClosure K ⊗[K] A) ≃ₐ[SeparableClosure K] Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) (SeparableClosure K)) (eB : (SeparableClosure K ⊗[K] B) ≃ₐ[SeparableClosure K] Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) (SeparableClosure K)) (a : Gal(SeparableClosure K/K) → Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin n) (SeparableClosure K)) (b : Gal(SeparableClosure K/K) → Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin m) (SeparableClosure K)) (ha : ∀ (g : Gal(SeparableClosure K/K)) (v : A), (eA (1 ⊗ₜ[K] v)).map g = ((a g)⁻¹).val * eA (1 ⊗ₜ[K] v) * (a g).val) (hb : ∀ (g : Gal(SeparableClosure K/K)) (v : B), (eB (1 ⊗ₜ[K] v)).map g = ((b g)⁻¹).val * eB (1 ⊗ₜ[K] v) * (b g).val) : ∃ e : (SeparableClosure K ⊗[K] (A ⊗[K] Bᵐᵒᵖ)) ≃ₐ[SeparableClosure K] Matrix (Fin (n * m)) (Fin (n * m)) (SeparableClosure K), ∀ (g : Gal(SeparableClosure K/K)) (v : A ⊗[K] Bᵐᵒᵖ), (e (1 ⊗ₜ[K] v)).map g = ((tensorOppositeMatrixLift (a g) (b g))⁻¹).val * e (1 ⊗ₜ[K] v) * (tensorOppositeMatrixLift (a g) (b g)).val
